Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 4

“Not by abstaining from actions does a person attain freedom from action, nor by renunciation alone does one reach perfection.”

The first correction: quitting is not the same as transcending. Krishna separates the outward act of dropping work from the inward freedom Arjuna imagines it would automatically bring.
